total-sift-objects.label: TOTAL SIFT OBJECTS
total-sift-objects.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean' AND is_dir = false

total-exfil-files.label: TOTAL EXFIL FILES
total-exfil-files.sql: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source = 'gcp_buckets' AND is_dir = false) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source = 'bigquery' AND is_dir = false)) AS total_count

sift-objects-bq-gcs.label: SIFT OBJECTS IN BQ AND GCS
sift-objects-bq-gcs.sql: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source = 'gcp_buckets' AND is_dir = false) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source = 'bigquery' AND is_dir = false)) AS total_count

sift-other-objects.label: SIFT OTHER OBJECTS
sift-other-objects.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean' AND source NOT IN ('gcp_buckets','bigquery') AND is_dir = false

preservation-total.label: PRESERVATION TOTAL
preservation-total.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files`) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE table_type = 'base table') AS total_count

files-for-harvesting.label: FILES FOR HARVESTING
files-for-harvesting.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files_enriched` WHERE has_sift_match = true) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE table_type = 'base table' AND total_rows > 0 AND sift_match = true) AS total_count

duplicates.label: DUPLICATES
duplicates.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT MD5Hex) AS duplicate_count FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files_enriched` WHERE has_sift_match = true

exclusions-bq.label: EXCLUSIONS
exclusions-bq.sql: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE table_type = 'base table' AND total_rows = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT MD5Hex FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files_enriched` WHERE extension IS NULL AND has_sift_match = TRUE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MD5Hex ORDER BY CreationDate ASC) = 1))) AS value

pending-extraction.label: PENDING FOR EXTRACTION
pending-extraction.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files_enriched` WHERE has_sift_match = true) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE table_type = 'base table' AND total_rows > 0 AND sift_match = true) - (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT MD5Hex) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files_enriched` WHERE has_sift_match = true) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE table_type = 'base table' AND total_rows = 0) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT MD5Hex FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files_enriched` WHERE extension IS NULL AND has_sift_match = TRUE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MD5Hex ORDER BY CreationDate ASC) = 1)) AS final_count

bq-files.label: BQ FILES
bq-files.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE table_type = 'base table' AND total_rows > 0 AND exclusion_flag IS NULL AND sift_match = true

gcs-files.label: GCS FILES
gcs-files.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files_enriched` WHERE has_sift_match = true) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE table_type = 'base table' AND total_rows > 0 AND sift_match = true) - (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT MD5Hex) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files_enriched` WHERE has_sift_match = true) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE table_type = 'base table' AND total_rows = 0) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT MD5Hex FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_files_enriched` WHERE extension IS NULL AND has_sift_match = TRUE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MD5Hex ORDER BY CreationDate ASC) = 1)) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE table_type = 'base table' AND total_rows > 0 AND exclusion_flag IS NULL AND sift_match = true) AS final_count

data-complexion.label: DATA COMPLEXION
data-complexion.sql: SELECT UNIQUE_COMBINATION, UNIQUE_VALUE_COMBINATIONS_COUNT, TOTAL_RECORD_COUNT FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.dashboard_summary.data_complexion` ORDER BY UNIQUE_VALUE_COMBINATIONS_COUNT DESC

person-id-types.label: PERSON ID TYPES
person-id-types.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(PERSON_ID_TYPE) IN ('workday', 'workdy id') THEN 'Workday ID' WHEN PERSON_ID_TYPE = 'EMPLOYEE ID' THEN 'Employee ID' ELSE PERSON_ID_TYPE END AS standardized_person_id_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.bronze.stg_dataload_person_raw` WHERE PERSON_ID_TYPE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN LOWER(PERSON_ID_TYPE) IN ('workday', 'workdy id') THEN 'Workday ID' WHEN PERSON_ID_TYPE = 'EMPLOYEE ID' THEN 'Employee ID' ELSE PERSON_ID_TYPE END ORDER BY record_count DESC

record-types.label: RECORD TYPES
record-types.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(RECORD_TYPE) LIKE '%person%' THEN 'Person (default)' ELSE RECORD_TYPE END AS standardized_record_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.bronze.stg_dataload_person_raw` WHERE RECORD_TYPE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN LOWER(RECORD_TYPE) LIKE '%person%' THEN 'Person (default)' ELSE RECORD_TYPE END ORDER BY record_count DESC

file-profiling.label: FILE PROFILING
file-profiling.sql: SELECT `Total Files`, `Deleted In TI`, `Duplicates`, `Exclusions`, `Potential Exclusions`, `Files For Harvesting`, `Total Files` - `Deleted In TI` - `Duplicates` - `Exclusions` - `Potential Exclusions` - `Files For Harvesting` AS `Pending Preservation` FROM (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean' AND is_dir = FALSE) AS `Total Files`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE deleted_in_ti IS NOT NULL) AS `Deleted In TI`, (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT MD5Hex) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE has_sift_match) AS `Duplicates`, ((SELECT COUNT(MD5Hex) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE Size = 0 AND has_sift_match) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE total_rows = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MD5Hex) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE extension IS NULL AND has_sift_match = TRUE AND BucketName IN ('prod-01-bucket-logs-8602ba','ii-prod-digitalseeds-bucket-logs-8602ba','aiweb-dev-telus-storage-logs-bucket-8602ba','aiweb-prod-telus-storage-logs-bucket-8602ba')) + 35000 + 9371) AS `Exclusions`, ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MD5Hex) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE extension IS NULL AND has_sift_match = TRUE AND BucketName IN ('rpa-dev-telus-bucket-logs-8602ba','sumsub-client-ti-is-sumsub-prod-01-8602ba')) + 23154 + 707292 + 4141) AS `Potential Exclusions`, ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE has_sift_match) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE Size = 0 AND has_sift_match) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.preservation_data.datalakeuniverse_pr_bg_tbl` WHERE total_rows = 0) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MD5Hex) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE extension IS NULL AND has_sift_match = TRUE AND BucketName IN ('prod-01-bucket-logs-8602ba','ii-prod-digitalseeds-bucket-logs-8602ba','aiweb-dev-telus-storage-logs-bucket-8602ba','aiweb-prod-telus-storage-logs-bucket-8602ba')) - 35000 - 9371 - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MD5Hex) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE extension IS NULL AND has_sift_match = TRUE AND BucketName IN ('rpa-dev-telus-bucket-logs-8602ba','sumsub-client-ti-is-sumsub-prod-01-8602ba')) - 23154 - 707292 - 4141 - (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT MD5Hex) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE has_sift_match)) AS `Files For Harvesting`) AS metrics

file-distribution.label: FILE DISTRIBUTION
file-distribution.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(extension) IN ('.avro','.csv','.parquet','.xlsx','.sql','.dtsx','.xls','.tsv') THEN 'Structured' WHEN LOWER(extension) IN ('.pdf','.txt','.log','.docx','.pptx','.md') THEN 'Unstructured' WHEN LOWER(extension) IN ('.jpg','.jpeg','.mov','.png','.mp4','.mp3','.log','.opus','.wav') THEN 'Media Files' WHEN LOWER(extension) IN ('.json','.xml','.jar','.py','.html','.xslt','.js') THEN 'Semi Structured/Technical Docs' ELSE 'Others' END AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT md5hex) AS count FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.gcs_discovery.gcs_datalakeuniverse_v1` WHERE has_sift_match = true AND Size != 0 AND exclusion_flag IS NULL AND MD5Hex != 'd41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e' AND BucketName NOT IN ('rpa-dev-telus-bucket-logs-8602ba','sumsub-client-ti-is-sumsub-prod-01-8602ba') GROUP BY category ORDER BY count DESC

wf-top.label: WATERFALL TOP
wf-top.sql: WITH total_files_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_files FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean'), dlu_metrics_cte AS (SELECT COUNTIF(item_type IN ('nuix_item', 'glean_doc')) AS dlu_total, COUNTIF(item_type = 'nuix_item') AS nuix_total, COUNTIF(item_type = 'glean_doc') AS glean_total FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.dlu.DataLakeUniverse`) SELECT (t.total_files + d.dlu_total) AS totalexfilFiles, d.nuix_total AS gcs_compressed, d.glean_total AS glen, ((t.total_files + d.dlu_total) - d.nuix_total - d.glean_total) AS bg_gcs_other_sources FROM total_files_cte t CROSS JOIN dlu_metrics_cte d

wf-zero.label: WATERFALL ZERO BYTE
wf-zero.sql: WITH total_files_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS bg_gcs_other_sources FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean'), zero_byte_files_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_byte_files FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean' AND is_dir = true) SELECT t.bg_gcs_other_sources AS TOTAL_FILES, z.zero_byte_files AS ZERO_BYTE_FILES, (t.bg_gcs_other_sources - z.zero_byte_files) AS final_variance FROM total_files_cte t CROSS JOIN zero_byte_files_cte z

harvest-metrics.label: HARVEST METRICS
harvest-metrics.sql: WITH sift_totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_files FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean'), zero_byte_metrics AS (SELECT ((SELECT COUNTIF(size = 0) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.dlu.DataLakeUniverse` WHERE item_type IN ('nuix_item', 'glean_doc')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean' AND is_dir = TRUE)) AS zero_byte_files), duplicate_metrics AS (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT md5) AS duplicate_count FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.dlu.DataLakeUniverse` WHERE item_type IN ('gcs_object', 'nuix_item')) SELECT s.total_files, z.zero_byte_files, d.duplicate_count FROM sift_totals s CROSS JOIN zero_byte_metrics z CROSS JOIN duplicate_metrics d

wf-sources.label: WATERFALL SOURCES
wf-sources.sql: WITH bq_files_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_bq, source FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean' AND is_dir = false AND source = 'bigquery' GROUP BY source), bq_preserved_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS bq_preserved FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.dlu.bq_dlu`), gcs_files_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count, source FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean' AND is_dir = false AND source = 'gcp_buckets' GROUP BY source), gcs_distinct_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT guid) AS distinct_gcs_count FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.dlu.gcs_dlu` WHERE match_sequence_id = 3), github_files_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_github, source FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean' AND is_dir = false AND source = 'github' GROUP BY source), github_preserved_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_preserved FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.dlu.github_dlu`), jira_files_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_jira, source FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE source != 'glean' AND is_dir = false AND source = 'jira' GROUP BY source), others_files_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_others, 'others' AS source FROM `cio-mosaic-analytics-pr-853ae3.sift_data.files` WHERE is_dir = false AND source NOT IN ('jira', 'github', 'gcp_buckets', 'bigquery', 'glean')) SELECT f.source AS source_type, CAST(f.total_bq AS STRING) AS total_files, CAST(b.bq_preserved AS STRING) AS preserved_files, '0' AS tideleted, CAST((f.total_bq - 0 - b.bq_preserved) AS STRING) AS tobe_preserved FROM bq_files_cte f CROSS JOIN bq_preserved_cte b UNION ALL SELECT gcs_f.source AS source_type, CAST(gcs_f.source_count AS STRING) AS total_files, CAST(g.distinct_gcs_count AS STRING) AS preserved_files, CAST((gcs_f.source_count - g.distinct_gcs_count) AS STRING) AS tideleted, CAST((gcs_f.source_count - g.distinct_gcs_count) AS STRING) AS tobe_preserved FROM gcs_files_cte gcs_f CROSS JOIN gcs_distinct_cte g UNION ALL SELECT git_f.source AS source_type, CAST(git_f.total_github AS STRING) AS total_files, CAST(p.total_preserved AS STRING) AS preserved_files, '0' AS tideleted, CAST((git_f.total_github - p.total_preserved) AS STRING) AS tobe_preserved FROM github_files_cte git_f CROSS JOIN github_preserved_cte p UNION ALL SELECT j.source AS source_type, CAST(j.total_jira AS STRING) AS total_files, 'tbd' AS preserved_files, 'tbd' AS tideleted, 'tbd' AS tobe_preserved FROM jira_files_cte j UNION ALL SELECT o.source AS source_type, CAST(o.total_others AS STRING) AS total_files, 'tbd' AS preserved_files, 'tbd' AS tideleted, 'tbd' AS tobe_preserved FROM others_files_cte o
